flags.text: Mourn's shit 11 deaths led the game; nine went to Sparrow, nearly half of Sparrow's 19 kills.

focus.title: Starve Sparrow, skip bad trades
focus.action: Draft one tank, swapping Countess offlane for Kaelen, Riktor or Aurora, and mix damage types. Once Sparrow gets ahead, Mourn and Lt. Belica trade only with Feng Mao in reach.

13.8.call: Sparrow killed Mourn and Lt. Belica, the enemy took Fangtooth, and Sparrow and Kaelen then killed Feng Mao and Gadget. With the duo down, give up the pit.

24.7.call: Lt. Belica destroyed the enemy duo outer, then the next fight was lost 0-2: Sparrow killed Lt. Belica and Greystone killed Feng Mao before the enemy Primal Fangtooth. Take the tower and reset together.

31.1.call: Lost 1-3: Feng Mao killed Kaelen, Sparrow killed Mourn and Feng Mao, Greystone killed Lt. Belica. After a Gadget death, the enemy took Primal Fangtooth. Three down means conceding the pit.

34.2.call: Countess fell to Greystone outside any detected fight and the allied offlane inner fell; the final fight went 1-4 with Sparrow scoring all four kills, and Orb Prime, the mid inner, inhibitor and Core went to the enemy. A body down, defend inside the base.

96e7b651-487a-45ad-ad8c-5dc829bfa45b: Nine of eleven deaths went to Sparrow; three of the eleven fell outside any detected fight. When Sparrow is unseen, wait for Lt. Belica before trading.
Fifteen wards beat a 5.5 norm and Narbash's 14, and four armor items were the only allied armor. Keep both, and ward the duo-lane jungle entrance before each trade.
a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: Recorded destroyer of the enemy offlane outer and inner towers, with 12.6 CS per minute on a 7.4 norm. When Greystone shows elsewhere, keep converting offlane towers the same way.
One assist and 6% kill participation; no kill or death credit in four fights after their offlane outer fell. Once it falls, call split or join before the next fight.
Two deaths, the allied low, and the late one to Greystone came outside any detected fight. With Greystone unseen late, play the offlane from the inner tower.
0d186c87-0ec3-4a5a-8bae-1eca6c1ca29e: 1738 hero damage per minute on a 1075 norm, plus two kills each on Kaelen and Renna. Open fights with Security Gate's root when the frontline is close.
Five deaths on a 3.3 norm, the last two to Sparrow, one outside any detected fight before the second enemy Primal Fangtooth. With Sparrow unseen, cross the jungle beside Mourn.
10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Four of six deaths went to Sparrow, against a single kill on Sparrow. When Sparrow leaves stealth, hold Seismic Assault's stun for that reveal, then follow with Neural Disruptor.
Five of six deaths came in the same fights as a Mourn death. When Mourn drops, disengage instead of trading on.
a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: First blood on Renna and six kills, the allied high, including three on Kaelen without a single Kaelen kill in return. Keep hunting Kaelen when Gadget can follow.
Two of three deaths to Greystone fell outside any detected fight, one shortly before an enemy Fangtooth. With Greystone unseen, clear the jungle beside Mourn or Gadget.
All seven deaths came from Sparrow or Greystone, with no armor item built. If Sparrow and Greystone lead again, slot Draconum for physical armor.

threats: Heal-stacking: Narbash. Anti-heal is mandatory against this comp — we brought 4 items of it.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Mourn Abduct (pull), Countess Feast (suppress 0.75s), Gadget Security Gate (root 1s), Lt. Belica Neural Disruptor (silence 0.5s). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
We have sustain (Mourn) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Our damage is 4/5 magical — predictable; one magic-resist item answers most of it. Mix in a physical threat.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Abduct pull → Contagion ally-heal bugs → Beguile damage-reduction → Eclipse vision-denial ult
ourKits.winCondition: pull a target in and sustain the team through the brawl
ourKits.playWith: burst that punishes his pulled target
ourKits.playAgainst: respect the long Abduct channel/range; anti-heal blunts Contagion

ourKits.combo: Shadow Slip in → Eventide → Blade Siphon → Feast suppress ult, Haemorrhage true-damage
ourKits.winCondition: Feast-suppress a squishy and delete them with true-damage burst
ourKits.passive: two-ability hits apply a %max-HP true-damage bleed
ourKits.playWith: a team to clean up after her pick
ourKits.playAgainst: Feast is her whole engage — bait it / peel; she's fragile, punish the recast window

ourKits.combo: Security Gate root → Sticky Mine → Tesla Dome zone ult
ourKits.winCondition: root with the gate and trap a fight inside the Tesla Dome
ourKits.passive: FDA stacks grant scaling magical power
ourKits.playWith: frontline that holds enemies in her Dome
ourKits.playAgainst: dodge the gate; spread vs the Dome — she's immobile, dive her

ourKits.combo: Seismic Assault knockup → Void Bomb → Neural Disruptor silence ult, Void Drone mana drain
ourKits.winCondition: knock up + silence a target and burst with missing-HP scaling
ourKits.playAgainst: dodge Seismic Assault; she's immobile — dive when ult is down

ourKits.combo: Reaping Dash → Hamstring slows → Safeguard spellshield → Earth Shatter execute
ourKits.winCondition: trade with the spellshield up and execute low targets with Earth Shatter
ourKits.passive: permanent power on unique hero takedowns
ourKits.playWith: setup that holds a target for the execute
ourKits.playAgainst: bait Safeguard's spellshield before committing the key CC

enemyKits.combo: Piercing Shot poke → Heightened Senses AS → Hail of Arrows zone → Inner Fire ult
enemyKits.winCondition: ramp Relentless + AS and sustained-DPS the front down
enemyKits.playWith: heavy peel — she's immobile and pure DPS
enemyKits.playAgainst: she has zero escape — hard-engage her and she dies first

enemyKits.combo: Soulfire waves → Mortal Coil pull-zone → Stupor orb → Abyssal Rift zone
enemyKits.winCondition: zone a fight with Mortal Coil + ult and chunk from range
enemyKits.passive: consumes essences from kills for power
enemyKits.playWith: frontline to hold enemies in her zones
enemyKits.playAgainst: fragile and reliant on her zones — flank/dive around the telegraphs

enemyKits.combo: Assault The Gates leap → Make Way armor shred → Sacred Oath empowered basic → Stone Forged Soul stasis ult
enemyKits.winCondition: front-line aggressively and reset the fight with the stasis heal
enemyKits.playWith: a team that fights while he soaks and stasis-resets
enemyKits.playAgainst: don't waste burst into his stasis — wait it out; anti-heal cuts the ult heal

enemyKits.combo: Thunk stun → March! speed → Song heal aura → Crash Bang Boom! AoE slow ult
enemyKits.winCondition: engage with Thunk and group-buff the team through fights
enemyKits.playWith: a dive team that rides his speed and heal
enemyKits.playAgainst: dodge/cleanse Thunk; he's low-damage — kill his carry through the aura
